class.name: PlayFabLobbyUpdateConfig
class.brief_description: Batched update request for an existing PlayFab lobby.
class.description:
Passed to [method PlayFabLobby.post_update_async] to change one or more lobby settings in a single service round trip. Fields are tracked by presence, not by value: a field is only sent when it has been explicitly assigned, so [code]false[/code] and enum value [code]0[/code] stay sendable instead of being indistinguishable from "leave unchanged". Assigning a property marks the field present; the matching [code]clear_*[/code] method returns it to "unchanged", and [method is_empty] reports whether anything is pending. Changing lobby configuration requires lobby ownership; non-owner callers receive a failure result from the service. [member new_owner_entity_key] is the exception — a non-owner may claim ownership when the lobby was created with [code]OWNER_MIGRATION_MANUAL[/code] or [code]OWNER_MIGRATION_NONE[/code], so no client-side owner check is applied. [codeblock] var update := PlayFabLobbyUpdateConfig.new() update.membership_lock = PlayFabLobbyUpdateConfig.MEMBERSHIP_LOCK_LOCKED update.access_policy = PlayFabLobbyUpdateConfig.ACCESS_POLICY_PRIVATE update.max_member_count = 4 update.search_properties = {"string_key1": "in_progress"}
var result = await lobby.post_update_async(update).completed if not result.ok: push_error("Lobby update failed: %s" % result.message) [/codeblock]

method.name: is_empty
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when no field has been assigned. Posting an empty update fails immediately with the [code]invalid_update[/code] error code instead of making a service call.

method.name: has_membership_lock
method.description: Returns whether [member membership_lock] was explicitly assigned.

method.name: has_access_policy
method.description: Returns whether [member access_policy] was explicitly assigned.

method.name: has_max_member_count
method.description: Returns whether [member max_member_count] was explicitly assigned.

method.name: has_restrict_invites_to_lobby_owner
method.description: Returns whether [member restrict_invites_to_lobby_owner] was explicitly assigned. Assigning [code]false[/code] still marks the field present, which is how the flag can be turned back off.

method.name: has_new_owner_entity_key
method.description: Returns whether [member new_owner_entity_key] was explicitly assigned.

method.name: has_search_properties
method.description: Returns whether [member search_properties] was explicitly assigned.

method.name: has_lobby_properties
method.description: Returns whether [member lobby_properties] was explicitly assigned.

members.member: Whether new members may join; use [code]MEMBERSHIP_LOCK_*[/code] constants. Locking closes the lobby to further joins without changing [member access_policy] and without removing existing members — use it to seal a lobby once a match starts.
Who can discover and join the lobby; use [code]ACCESS_POLICY_*[/code] constants. Values mirror [PlayFabLobbyConfig], so the same constant works at create time and at update time.

New member capacity. Must be between [code]2[/code] and [code]128[/code] inclusive and must not be below the lobby's current member count. Unlike [method PlayFabMultiplayer.create_lobby_async], which clamps, out-of-range values here fail with the [code]invalid_update[/code] error code so a shrink that would evict members is never silently rewritten.

When true, only the lobby owner can invite. [b]Requires the April 2026 GDK ([code]260400[/code]+).[/b] On the October 2025 GDK, posting an update that assigns this field fails with the [code]unsupported_on_gdk_edition[/code] error code.

Entity key of the member to transfer ownership to, as [code]{"id": ..., "type": ...}[/code]. Both entries are required and must be non-empty; otherwise the update fails with [code]invalid_update[/code].

Search string properties to write (the [member PlayFabLobbyConfig.search_properties] bucket). Keys must use the reserved [code]string_keyN[/code] / [code]number_keyN[/code] names PlayFab requires for search. Values must be [String] or [StringName], or [code]null[/code] to delete that key; omitted keys are left unchanged.

Member-visible lobby properties to write (the [member PlayFabLobbyConfig.lobby_properties] bucket). Values must be [String] or [StringName], or [code]null[/code] to delete that key; omitted keys are left unchanged. Equivalent to [method PlayFabLobby.set_properties_async] when it is the only assigned field.

constants.constant: New members may not join. Existing members stay in the lobby.
